title: A quick start guide to the scider package
text: scider can conduct grid-based density analysis spatial transcriptomics data.

title: A quick start guide to the scider package
text: can perform density calculation cell type using function gridDensity. calculated density grid information saved metadata SpatialExperimnet object. can visualise overall cell density whole tissue using function plotDensity.  can also visualise density individual cell type, e.g., fibroblast cells.

title: A quick start guide to the scider package
text: obtaining grid-based density COI, can detect regions--interest (ROIs) based density select user.

title: A quick start guide to the scider package
text: detect ROIs automatically, can use function findROI. detected ROIs saved metadata SpatialExperiment object. identify ROIs based fibroblasts cell density. can visualise ROIs function plotROI.

title: A quick start guide to the scider package
text: Alternatively, users can select ROIs based research interest (drawn hand). can done using function selectRegion. function open interactive window interactive plot users zoom-/-select ROI using either rectangular lasso selection tool. Users can also press Export selected points button save ROIs object R environment. closing interactive window, selected ROI saved data.frame object named sel_region R environment. can use postSelRegion save ROI metadata SpatialExperiment object. Similarly, can plot visualise user-defined ROI function plotROI.
code: selectRegion(metadata(spe)$grid_density, x.col = "x_grid", y.col = "y_grid") sel_region spe1 <- postSelRegion(spe, sel_region = sel_region)  metadata(spe1)$roi plotROI(spe1)

title: scider 1.4.0 (2024-10-30)
text: gridDensity() now supports hexagonal grids. Make ‘grid.length.x’ = 100 default gridDensity() remove default value ‘ngrid.x’. New functions plotGrid() gridSPE() gridSPE() option calculate grid-level count matrix cell type Remove redundant argument ‘n’ plotSpatial() Rename ‘coi’ ‘contour’, ‘’ ‘self.included’ plotCellCompo() Fixed bug plotContour() ‘overlay’ working properly Fixed bug corDensity() produced NaN values New argument ‘contour’ allocateCells() allowing user specify contour levels cell allocation. Default detected contours. corDensity() can run without running findROI(), returns DataFrame instead list DataFrames ROI detected. New argument ‘probs’ added plotDensity() grid filtering ROIs identified previously. ‘equal.cell’ set TRUE default getContour(). plotContour() now plots contour cells ‘coi’ NULL (default). ‘coi’ contains multiple cell types, plotContour() looks corresponding contour spe@metadata plotting. Added another option ‘none’ ‘overlay’ plotContour(). multiple ‘coi’, getContour() now includes coi contour labelling. gridDensity() returns extra column ‘density_overall’ spe@metadata$grid_density. plotDensity() plots overall cell density default. default value ‘probs’ plotDensity() now 0.5. multiple ‘coi’, plotDensity() now plots total instead average. Fixed ggtitle() bug plotDensity() ‘coi’ contains one cell type. findROI() now use cells (overall) default. coord_fixed plotDensity() plotROI(). plotROI() now plots cells background ‘roi’ ‘overall’. corDensity(), ‘trace’ now set FALSE default. Fixed bug cellsInRegion() one ROI. Fixed bugs contour2sf() ‘areas_up’. Converted cell numbers vector spe2PB(). Fixed bug spe2PB() count table spe matrix. Fixed bug plotContour() ensure exact match cell types avoid similar cell type names.
